contentPattern.structure: repeating items: question | answer (richtext); first 3 visible, Show more reveals the rest

suitableFor: long question lists that should start collapsed
notSuitableFor: full-width content accordions with long rich sections (use accordion)

implementationNote: Block-based component (block/v1/block) with repeating faq-list-item items (question text + answer richtext). Renders details/summary boxes; items beyond the first 3 are hidden until the generated 'Show more' button is clicked.
